Full product name: Nitro Basher Snowboard (also referred to as "Nitro Quiver Series Basher") [2][3] 4. Model year: 2026 (25/26 season) [1][2] 5. Product tagline: "The Original Friendly Freestyle ATV" [2] 6. Model series: Quiver Series [3] 7. Gender: Men's [3] 8. Manufacturer corporate entity: Nitro AG, Bösch 104, 6331 Hünenberg, Switzerland [4] 9. EU Representative: Nitro Distribution Italia S.R.L., Via A. Moro 51, 38062 Arco (TN), Italia [4] 10. US Distribution: Foundry Distribution, 3602 Via Terra, Salt Lake City, UT 84115 [5] 11. Brand founded: 1990 at Vera's Café, Ballard, Seattle, Washington [6] 12. Founders: Thomas (Tommy) Delago and Sepp Ardelt [6] 13. Brand age: 35+ years (this is the brand's 35th snowboard collection) [7] 14. Ownership: Privately held, co-founder Tommy Delago still co-owner and board builder [8] 15. Product development location: Oberammergau, Bavaria, Germany [9] 16. Manufacturing location: Playmaker factory, Taiwan (moved from Elan factory in Austria circa 2012) [10] 17. Predecessor model: The Basher was first introduced for the 2024 (23/24) season as a new addition to the Quiver lineup [11] 18. 2024 model first year description: "Nitro is proud to introduce the first friendly-freestyle board into the Quiver line-up" [11] 19. YouTube review published: 2024 model first reviewed September 11, 2023 [12] --- PRICING & AVAILABILITY --- 20. MSRP (USD): $599.95 [13] 21. MSRP (EUR): €649.90 [14] 22. MSRP (AUD): $999.99 [MERCHANT] 23. MSRP variant note: Both 155MW and 158W are the same price (AUD $999.99) [MERCHANT] 24. Review-stated MSRP: $599.99 (DISAGREMENT – slight $0.04 difference vs retailer $599.95; likely rounding) [15] 25. Price at evo (sale): $419.91 (30% off $599.95) [16] 26. Price at Tactics (sale): $419.95 (30% off) [17] 27. Price at Getboards: $599.95 [18] 28. Price at Board of Missoula (sale): $480.00 (regular $600.00) [19] 29. Price at One80 Boardshop (EUR, sale): €584.95 (regular €649.95, 10% off) [20] 30. Price at Ri-fun (EUR, sale): €422.50 [21] 31. Price at Nitro USA/Foundry: $599.95 [22] 32. 2025 model previous-season price at Milosport: $480.00 (discounted from $599.95) [23] 33. Availability at evo: In stock [16] 34. Availability at Tactics: In stock (155mw size) [17] 35. Availability at Getboards: In stock [18] 36. Availability at ERIK'S: Available, warehouse fulfillment in 4-9 days [24] 37. Availability at The Source Snowboard & Skate: Available, 30-day return/exchange [25] 38. Availability at Board of Missoula: Available [19] 39. Availability at Gear West: Available, ships via UPS/USPS [26] 40. Availability at Melbourne Snowboard (Australia): Available [27] 41. Availability at One80 Boardshop (EU): 158W available [20] 42. Availability on Amazon: Listed (2025 model confirmed; 2026 TBD) [28] --- CORE SPECIFICATIONS (MANUFACTURER OFFICIAL) --- 43. Available sizes: 155mw (Mid-Wide), 158w (Wide) [14] 44. Shape: Asym Twin (asymmetric twin) [14] 45. Shape (DISAGREEMENT - One80 Boardshop): True Twin [20] — Comment: One80 Boardshop lists "True Twin" while all other sources including the manufacturer state "Asym Twin." The manufacturer spec is authoritative. 46. Camber type: Flat-Out Rocker (flat between bindings with early rise in nose and tail) [14] 47. Camber (DISAGREEMENT - Wobble Snow): "Cam-Out Camber" [29] — Comment: Wobble Snow uses "Cam-Out Camber" while the manufacturer and virtually all other sources say "Flat-Out Rocker." The manufacturer spec is authoritative. 48. Flex rating: 7/10 [14] 49. Flex (DISAGREEMENT - One80 Boardshop): 5/10 [20] — Comment: One80 appears to have generated auto-description text and lists a lower flex. The manufacturer and all major retailers confirm 7/10. 50. Flex (DISAGREEMENT - 2024 model, Saint Bernard): 8/10 [30] — Comment: The 2024 model was listed as flex 8; SnowboardingProfiles also listed 2024 as 8/10. The 2026 model is 7/10 per manufacturer. 51. Core material: PowerCore II — tip-to-tail Poplar wood core with Beech wood stringers [14] 52. Core profile: Reflex Core Profile (thinner core between feet for improved handling and torsional flex) [14] 53. Laminate: Bi-Lite Laminates (biaxial fiberglass, fibres in two directions) [14][27] 54. Base material: Sintered EcoSpeed HD Base (recycled material compound; 85% post-industrial Ptex) [14][27] 55. Sidewall material: ABS Sidewalls (35% recycled polymers, cold-resistant and durable) [14] 56. Edge material: 50% Recycled Steel edges [14] 57. Resin: EcoPoxy33 (over 33% plant and vegetable derived molecular structure) [14][27] 58. Topsheet: EcoGuard Topsheet (90% post-industrial recycled material) [14][27] 59. Factory wax: Green Speed Natural Wax (100% biodegradable, made from renewable resources) [14] 60. Mounting pattern: 2x4 Inserts [MERCHANT][30] 61. Sidecut type: Dual Degressive (smaller radius center, two larger in tip and tail) [14] 62. 3D base technology: 3D Twin Tech (convex nose → concave center → convex tail) [14] 63. Setback: 0mm (both sizes) [14] 64. Ink type: Water-based inks [14] --- SIZE-SPECIFIC SPECS: 155 Mid-Wide --- 65. Running length (155mw): 1020mm [14] 66. Nose width (155mw): 303mm [14] 67. Tail width (155mw): 303mm [14] 68. Waist width (155mw): 256mm (25.6cm) [14][17] 69. Sidecut (155mw): 9.0/5.5/9.0, 7.7/5.2/7.7 m [14] 70. Stance range (155mw): 48-60cm / 18.9-23.6" [14] 71. Recommended rider weight (155mw): 60+ kg / 130+ lbs [14] 72. Suggested boot size (155mw): US 11 & under [17] --- SIZE-SPECIFIC SPECS: 158 Wide --- 73. Running length (158w) per Nitro official site: 1150mm [14] — DISAGREEMENT with merchant data (1060mm). Comment: The official Nitro website's specs table clearly shows 1150mm for the 158w. The merchant-provided data states 1060mm. This is a notable discrepancy; the manufacturer source is likely authoritative, but the merchant may have an older or different spec sheet. 74. Running length (158w) per merchant data: 1060mm [MERCHANT] — See disagreement above. 75. Nose width (158w): 309mm [14] 76. Tail width (158w): 309mm [14] 77. Waist width (158w): 260mm [14] 78. Sidecut (158w): 9.3/6.0/9.3, 8.4/5.5/8.4 m [14] 79. Stance range (158w): 52-64cm / 20.5-25.2" [14] 80. Recommended rider weight (158w): 70+ kg / 155+ lbs [14] 81. Setback (158w): 0mm [14] --- TERRAIN RATINGS (MANUFACTURER) --- 82. All Mountain rating: 10/10 [14][19] 83. Park rating: 8/10 [14][19] 84. Backcountry rating: 9/10 [14][19] 85. Flex rating (riding attribute): 7/10 [14] 86. Park rating (DISAGREEMENT - Boardworks Tech Shop 2025 model): 5/10 [31] — Comment: 2025 model specs at Boardworks list Park at 5/10 vs 2026's 8/10. This may reflect a spec change between years or an error. --- SUSTAINABILITY FEATURES --- 87. Manufacturing energy: 100% solar power [14] 88. Forestry certification: FSC certified wood core [14] 89. Carbon footprint: 32.2 kg CO₂ [14][15] 90. Recycled steel edge percentage: 50% recycled [14] 91. EcoSpeed Base recycled content: 85% post-industrial Ptex base materials [27] 92. EcoGuard Topsheet recycled content: 90% post-industrial recycled material [27] 93. Resin eco credentials: EcoPoxy33 — over 33% plant/vegetable derived [27] 94. Part of Nitro's Quiver Eco Lab initiative [15] --- WARRANTY --- 95. Warranty period: 2 years from date of purchase [32][33] 96. Warranty coverage: Structural defects in materials and workmanship only [32][33] 97. Warranty exclusions: Impact damage, abuse, misuse, normal wear and tear, rock/rail hits [32] 98. Warranty transferability: Non-transferable; original purchaser only [33] 99. Warranty claim process: Through authorized dealer where purchased [33] --- RIDE CHARACTERISTICS & REVIEWS --- 100. Reviewer overall feel: "one of those boards that just makes snowboarding fun" [15] 101. Ride feel: Intuitive, playful, but capable [15] 102. Performance in variable conditions: Thrived in slushy groomers, chopped-up snow, and variable conditions [15] 103. Speed stability: Stays stable without feeling stiff or demanding at speed [15] 104. Carving performance: Excels at euro-carving at slow to mid speeds; smooth and surfy turn feel [15] 105. Turn initiation: Easy and smooth thanks to asym twin shape [15] 106. Heelside performance: Deeper heelside sidecut makes heelside turns confident and effortless [15] 107. 3D Twin Tech feel: Forgiving, catch-free, and super playful when buttering or in slush [15] 108. Powder performance: Surprisingly floaty and maneuverable; easy to slash and redirect [15] 109. Park performance: Forgiving and solid underfoot; easy to press, stable on landings [15] 110. Park limitation: Not a pure park deck, but handles freestyle better than expected [15] 111. Base speed: Fast sintered base; no problem carrying speed [15] 112. Flex description per The Source: "Nitro's most versatile flex pattern, combining great pop and smooth response" [25] 113. Knut Eliassen (Nitro team) endorsement: Calls it "one of the most fun boards I have ever ridden" [34] 114. Knut Eliassen recommended use: Slow-speed carving, buttering rollers, mellow freestyle in and out of park [34] 115. Board category per wobblesnow: "freestyle/all-mountain twin with extra punch" [29] 116. Target rider (wobblesnow): Intermediate to advanced freestyle riders [29] 117. Not recommended for: Beginners or riders who mainly ride deep powder [29] 118. Forum sentiment: Described as "pretty under the radar" on snowboardingforum.com [35] 119. Review test setup: Tested in 155 size with Union Ultra bindings (Medium), Adidas Tactical ADV 9.5 boots, 22.5" stance, rider 5'9" / 175 lbs [15] 120. Board type per Melbourne Snowboard: All Mountain [27] --- DESIGN & TECHNOLOGY DETAILS --- 121. Asym Twin shape explanation: Based on knowledge that knees don't bend the same way in both directions; deeper heel sidecut radius compensates for asymmetric knee bend [14] 122. Dual Degressive Sidecut description: Nitro's most forgiving sidecut [14] 123. 3D Twin Tech description: Twintip evolution of 3D Surf Tech; convex nose → concave center → convex tail for loose and surfy feel in both directions [14] 124. Flat-Out Rocker profile: Hybrid Zero Camber profile; nose and tail lift off before traditional contact points [3] 125. Flat-Out Rocker riding benefits: Effortless turns, catch-free maneuvers, excellent float, pressability, forgiveness [3] 126. Flat-Out Rocker target riders: Park, freestyle, and urban riders worldwide [14] 127. Reflex Core Profile benefit: Thinner core between feet improves handling and torsional flex [14] 128. ABS sidewall recycled content: 35% recycled polymers [14] 129. Mid-Wide width description: "Exactly enough platform for most boot sizes" [14] 130. Wide width description: "All the room you need without edge-to-edge lag" [14] 131. Board based on predecessor: Optisym's asymmetric "Friendly Freestyle" ride [14] --- COMPARABLE / COMPETITOR PRODUCTS --- 132. Within Nitro lineup - Dinghy (Quiver): Same price $599.95; volume-shifted short/wide board for powder float + groomer playfulness [16][29] 133. Within Nitro lineup - Banker (Quiver): Same price $599.95; carving machine, stiffer flex, directional shape for speed [16][29] 134. Within Nitro lineup - Alternator: $579.95; progressive all-mountain board, directional, freeride/all-mountain blend [16] 135. Within Nitro lineup - Team: $579.95; Nitro's flagship freestyle board [16] 136. Within Nitro lineup - Cheap Thrills: True twin freestyle with Cam-Out Camber for park progression [29] 137. Cross-brand competitor suggestion by Tactics: Jones Stratos ($669.95), Ride Twinpig, Lib Tech Skate Banana BTX, CAPiTA Aeronaut [17] 138. Cross-brand all-mountain freestyle alternatives: Ride Twinpig ($398.95 on sale), K2 Sky Pilot ($440.95 on sale), Burton Counterbalance ($461.95 on sale) [17] --- RETAILER REPUTATION & SERVICES --- 139. evo reputation: Major US online/brick-and-mortar retailer; lowest price guarantee, beat competitors by 5%, free shipping [16] 140. Tactics reputation: Established US snowboard/skate retailer since 1999; low price guarantee, free shipping over $250 [17] 141. ERIK'S services: Price match within 10 days, free binding installation with board+binding purchase, free wax coupon, in-store expert guidance [24] 142. Getboards services: 30-day returns, no sales tax outside California, price match, 1-year manufacturer warranty [18] 143. The Source return policy: 30-day return/exchange on unworn/unused product [25] 144. Board of Missoula: Local independent shop [19] 145. Melbourne Snowboard (Australia): Local independently owned store, 30-day exchange/credit (no change-of-mind refunds) [27] 146. Gear West: Ships via UPS/USPS [26] 147. Nitro USA (Foundry Distribution) direct: 14-day return policy for unused products [5] --- BRAND REPUTATION & CONTEXT --- 148. Nitro's industry reputation: One of the oldest snowboarding companies in the world, one of the last privately owned [36] 149. Nitro brand innovations (historical): First mass-produced splitboard, asymmetric camber profiles, mini disc binding system, first women's pro model [36] 150. Nitro's 25/26 collection: Their 35th snowboard collection [7] 151. Nitro's approach to retail: Does not sell direct to consumer online (USA); supports retailer network [37] 152. Annual revenue (Nitro Snowboards): ~$5.6 million (2026, per RocketReach estimate) [38] 153. Employee count: ~81 employees [38] 154. Nitro Snowboards produces: Snowboards, bindings, boots, bags/luggage, apparel, socks [6] 155. SKU for 155MW: 833204-001 [MERCHANT] --- MISCELLANEOUS DECISION FACTORS --- 156. Riding terrain per merchant: All Mountain, Park, Powder, Freestyle [MERCHANT] 157. Riding style per merchant: Freestyle, switch riding, carving [MERCHANT] 158. Flex description per merchant: Mid-flex (balanced blend of flexibility and stiffness) [MERCHANT] 159. Width options description per manufacturer: Mid-Wide and Wide [14] 160. Board usable switch: Yes — 3D Twin Tech designed for forward and switch riding equally [14] 161. Sintered base maintenance note: Sintered bases absorb and hold wax better for faster performance but require more frequent wax application [24] 162. Board not folding/collapsing: Standard solid snowboard (no splitboard variant) 163. Binding compatibility: Any binding with standard or mini disk fits 2x4 inserts [27] 164. Previous year (2024) base type was Sintered Speed Formula HD (not EcoSpeed HD) [11] — base formula changed/renamed for sustainability in subsequent years 165. Nitro Australia distributor: Unit 15, 42-44 Garden Blvd, Dingley Village 3172, Victoria [39]
